heic-to 1.6.6 by Hopper Gee
License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0; see LICENSE.txt.
Source and build instructions: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
Package source: https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.6.tgz
Upstream dependency: libheif 1.23.6 (https://github.com/strukturag/libheif).

The unmodified heic-to/csp module is bundled as a separately loaded admin-only
JavaScript chunk. To replace it, install a compatible heic-to package in this
project and rebuild with npm run build. It loads only when an administrator
selects a HEIC/HEIF image; existing JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF and PDF uploads do not
load the decoder. The website source is available at:
https://github.com/Jayszrs/jayszrs-portfolio
